name: Geelong Wet Paws Mobile Dog Wash & Grooming
areaText: Based at Bell Post Hill and covering Geelong and surrounding suburbs. Ask about your area when you book.
seoTitle: Mobile Dog Wash & Grooming in Geelong
metaDesc: Mobile dog wash and grooming across Geelong. Luke is calm and patient with first grooms, big coats and cranky seniors. Call 0428 828 621.

hero.title: Mobile dog wash. Geelong.
hero.lede: Luke brings the wash, the dryer and the clippers to your door. Patient with first-timers, cranky seniors and the big fluffy ones.

servicesSub: Everything happens in the van outside your place, one dog at a time.

services.title: Wash & dry
services.short: Warm hydrobath, coat-matched shampoo, full blow-dry and brush.
services.long: A warm hydrobath with shampoo to suit the coat, then a full blow-dry and brush-out. Big double coats like goldens and shepherds come up soft and shed far less afterwards.

services.title: Full groom
services.short: Clip or scissor cut, face and feet tidy, ears cleaned.
services.long: A complete groom: wash, dry, clip or scissor cut, plus a tidy of the face, feet and hygiene areas and an ear clean. Luke is persistent with coats that other groomers have struggled with.

services.title: Nail trims
services.short: Even for dogs who usually won't let anyone near their paws.
services.long: Calm, careful nail trims that owners say their dogs actually tolerate. Add it to any wash, or book it on its own.

services.title: Puppy first groom
services.short: A short, gentle first session so grooming starts on a good note.
services.long: A short, positive introduction to the bath, the dryer and being handled. It sets puppies up for easy grooms for life.

whyText: You deal with Luke from the first call to the last brush stroke. Owners say he's calm, down to earth and persistent with coats other groomers gave up on.
why: No salon, no cages, no car trip
Great with golden retrievers and big coats
gallerySub: Washed, dried and ready for the beach again.
reviewsHead: What Geelong owners say about Luke

reviews.text: Luke was fantastic grooming our two golden retrievers. He was very persistent in giving us our best groom yet.
So glad I found a groomer who my dog will let clip his claws! Luke groomed both my dogs and he was very good.
Luke was a dream with our Georgie's first grooming experience. Knowledgeable, down to earth, calm and caring.
Thank you so very much for grooming our very stubborn maltese shih tzu's first groom. Excellent service.
Would 100% recommend, he knows what he's doing. Looking forward to our next visit!
My older dog is a bit cranky these days but Luke did a great job and I plan on continuing to use his services.

faq: Geelong and surrounding suburbs. Let us know your suburb when you book and we'll confirm.
Do I need to provide water or power?
No. The van is fully self-contained.
Can you groom an older or grumpy dog?
Yes. Luke takes his time and many of his regulars are seniors.
aboutParas: Geelong Wet Paws is a one-man mobile grooming service run by Luke, based at Bell Post Hill.
Because Luke does every groom himself, your dog sees the same face each time, which makes a big difference for nervous dogs, seniors and puppies.
The fully equipped van means no car trips and no waiting in a busy salon. Just a calm groom, right outside your door.
values: No rushing, especially with first-timers and seniors.
Done at your door, Monday to Friday.
contactSub: Send a request below and Luke will get back to you with a time.
bandText: Book Luke for a wash this week.
footerBlurb: Mobile dog wash and grooming across Geelong, run by Luke.
